== Gameplay ==
[[File:Grand Theft Auto VI combat.jpg|thumb|left|Gameplay screenshot of a player as Jason Duval shooting at a police vehicle, featuring the overhauled wanted system|upright=1.1]]

''Grand Theft Auto VI'' is a [[single-player]], [[action-adventure game]] set within an [[open world]] and played from a [[Third-person (video games)|third-person]] view as either Jason Duval or [[Lucia Caminos]]. Players can choose to fight [[non-player character]]s (NPCs), steal vehicles, rob establishments or get into high-speed chases with the police.<ref name="Website-1">{{Cite web |last1=Purslow
